$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

server.description: Server configuration for ax-code serve and web commands

hostname.description: Loopback hostname to listen on; network binds are disabled

cors.description: Additional loopback origins to allow for CORS

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

directoryScope.description: Controls the startup guard against launching ax-code in an overly broad directory.

enabled.description: Warn before indexing an unusually broad directory (home, Desktop, Downloads, Documents, a filesystem root, or a very large top-level listing). Default: true.

maxTopLevelEntries.description: Top-level entry count above which a directory is treated as broad. Default: 300.

extraDenylist.description: Additional absolute paths always treated as broad.

snapshot.description: Enable or disable snapshot tracking. When false, filesystem snapshots are not recorded and undoing or reverting will not undo/redo file changes. Defaults to true.

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

shell.description: Default shell to use for terminal and bash tool (e.g. /bin/bash, /usr/bin/zsh). Overrides $SHELL environment variable.

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg openai/gpt-5

llm_routing.description: Explicit ordered recovery targets. Empty by default; only user-owned config grants targets.

small_model.description: Explicit auxiliary model in provider/model format. When omitted, auxiliary tasks inherit the selected model.

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'build' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

username.description: Custom username to display in conversations instead of system username

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

tier.description: Agent visibility tier: core (always shown in picker), specialist (expandable, accessed via @-mention), internal (hidden)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

axTrust.description: Send X-AX-Prompt-Cache-Key for AX Trust session affinity. AX Trust connections send it by default; set false to disable. Other providers send it only when true.

anyOf.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to this provider. Default is 300000 (5 minutes). Set to false to disable timeout.
Disable timeout for this provider entirely.

chunkTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks for this provider. If no chunk arrives within this window, the request is aborted.

toolProfile.description: Tool surface: "coding" focuses on coding, delegation and verification; "full" exposes every enabled tool (cloud default). AX Engine defaults to the smaller "core" profile.

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 30000 (30 seconds) if not specified.

webmcp.description: Experimental pinned WebMCP bridge policy; requires explicit enablement and interactive approval for every call

allowedOrigins.description: Exact permitted origins; no wildcards, credentials, paths, queries or fragments. Empty (the product default) navigates any http(s) origin; a non-empty list narrows navigation to exactly those origins.

headless.description: Use an isolated headless Chrome instead of a visible window

persistentProfile.description: Use a persistent AX-owned browser profile so authenticated WebMCP tools work. Requires the managed allowPersistentProfile requirement and forces a visible window.

vendored.description: Launch a vendored, integrity-pinned bridge install instead of npx. Requires the managed allowVendored requirement.

read.description: Enable the T1 read tier: page snapshot, screenshot and console tools for granted origins. Default off. A managed allowRead: false forces it off.

interact.description: Enable the T2 interact tier: click, hover, wait_for, fill, fill_form, press_key and handle_dialog for granted origins, each confirmed interactively. Default off. A managed allowInteract: false forces it off.

executablePath.description: Optional explicit Chrome 150+ executable; never attaches to an existing browser session

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

allowLoopback.description: Opt in to localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1] HTTP(S) MCP on the configured origin only. Defaults to false; project entries still require trust.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 30000 (30 seconds) if not specified.

anyOf.description: MCP server config. Tools surface as permission keys `<server>_<tool>` — use the top-level `permission` map (with wildcards) to allow / deny them, or scope them per agent via `agent.<name>.permission`.

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

autonomy.description: Autonomous workload budgets and stall breakers. Prefer this over scattering limits across session and experimental keys. See /limits.

profile.description: Named workload profile that seeds budget defaults: quick (tight), standard (shipped defaults), long (multi-file batches), goal (goal-scale headroom), custom (no profile seeds). Explicit autonomy.budget / session.* fields always win over the profile.

budget.description: First-class autonomy budgets. Takes precedence over session.* and experimental.autonomous_caps when set.

per_segment.description: Outer-loop steps per auto-continuation segment (alias: session.max_steps; default 500)

total.description: Cumulative outer-loop steps across continuations, goals, and Super-Long (alias: session.max_total_steps)

continuations.description: Auto-continuations after a per-segment step limit (alias: session.max_continuations; default 3)

todo_retries.description: Auto-continuations while todos remain pending (alias: session.max_todo_retries; default 10)

per_segment.description: Blast-radius tool-call ceiling per continuation (alias: experimental.autonomous_caps.steps; default 500)

count.description: Max tool calls in a rolling window (default 30). Protects against parallel tool floods.

window_seconds.description: Rolling window length in seconds for the tool-call rate limit (default 10)

per_tool.description: Per-tool call-count caps (alias: experimental.autonomous_caps.perTool). 0 or negative disables.

files_total.description: Max distinct files changed in an autonomous run (alias: experimental.autonomous_caps.files)

lines_exempt_paths.description: Glob patterns whose writes count toward the file cap but not the line cap — lockfiles and generated snapshots by default (alias: experimental.autonomous_caps.linesExemptPaths)

stall.description: Stall / loop breakers that are independent of workload step ceilings

tool_only_turns.description: Hard stop after this many consecutive tool-only model finishes (default 35)

tool_only_nudge.description: First synthesis checkpoint during a tool-only streak (default 15)

tool_only_final_nudge.description: Final warning checkpoint before the hard stop (default max-5)

failed_mutation_attempts.description: Segment-cumulative cap on failed mutating tool attempts (edit/write/multiedit/apply_patch/todowrite that errored). Reset by a successful mutation or a text finish. Bounds fail -> read -> fail loops that evade the consecutive all-error ladder (default 30).

max_consecutive_errors.description: Hard stop after this many consecutive provider/tool errors in the outer loop (default 3). Raise to tolerate flaky providers; lower for stricter failure handling.

super_long.description: Enable Super-Long supervised long-run mode (default: on for models with a 64k+ context window, thinking, and prompt caching — e.g. Qwen 3.7 Max/Plus; off otherwise)

duration_hours.description: Runtime ceiling for a Super-Long run in hours (default and hard maximum: 72)

pacing_grace_minutes.description: Minutes from run start before provider request pacing engages (default 120). The grace window keeps the productive early phase of an agentic run unthrottled; 0 paces from the first request.

mode.description: Isolation mode: read-only blocks all mutations, workspace-write allows writes inside workspace only, full-access disables isolation. Defaults to full-access (sandbox off)

network.description: Allow network access from tools. Defaults to enabled in full-access and disabled in read-only and workspace-write modes

protected.description: Additional paths relative to workspace root that are protected from writes. .git and .ax-code are always protected

backend.description: Isolation enforcement backend: app (portable tool checks, default), os (kernel sandbox for bash when available), auto (prefer os with app fallback)

webmcp.description: Enterprise WebMCP requirement for the experimental chrome-devtools bridge. Managed config only — ignored from project, user, remote and inline config so a repository cannot set or loosen it. allow: false blocks the bridge; allowedOrigins narrows the exact origins admitted. A managed allow never enables the bridge and never bypasses the per-call interactive webmcp approval.

allow.description: Managed allow/deny for the experimental WebMCP bridge. false blocks the bridge entirely.

allowedOrigins.description: Managed narrowing list. When set, only these exact origins stay usable: an unrestricted profile narrows to this list; a configured profile is intersected with it and an empty intersection fails closed.

allowPersistentProfile.description: Managed opt-in for a persistent AX-owned browser profile. Default off; never the user's main profile.

allowVendored.description: Managed opt-in for a vendored, integrity-pinned bridge install instead of npx. Default off.

allowRead.description: Managed gate for the T1 read tier. Default off. false forces the read tools off even when the profile sets read: true; it can only restrict, never enable.

allowInteract.description: Managed gate for the T2 interact tier. false forces the interact tools off even when the profile sets interact: true; it can only restrict, never enable.

ttl_days.description: Auto-prune sessions older than this many days (default: 30)

auto_prune.description: Automatically prune expired sessions on startup (default: true)

max_steps.description: Maximum agentic steps per session turn before stopping (default: 500)

max_continuations.description: In autonomous mode, how many times to auto-continue after hitting step limit (default: 3, 0 to disable)

max_total_steps.description: Hard ceiling on cumulative steps across ALL auto-continuations, including active goals and Super-Long runs (default: max_steps × (max_continuations + 1); active-goal and Super-Long runs default: max_steps × 40). When the ceiling ends an active-goal run, the goal is paused and resumable with /goal resume

max_todo_retries.description: In autonomous mode, how many times to auto-continue when todos remain pending after the model stops (default: 10, 0 to disable)

routing.description: Specialist agent auto-routing and message-complexity routing settings

disable.description: Disable automatic specialist agent routing based on message keywords. Default: false.

mode.description: @deprecated Routing mode is no longer used. Field accepted for backwards compatibility but ignored.

auto_switch.description: @deprecated Use routing.disable instead. Field accepted for backwards compatibility but ignored.

llm.description: Enable LLM-based message-complexity classification so simple queries use a small/fast model. Default: false unless the AX_CODE_SMART_LLM flag is set.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: true)

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

interceptOpen.description: Intercept browser-open commands (open/xdg-open/start) targeting local HTML files or localhost URLs to prevent unexpected focus-steals during HTML development. Defaults to true.

cdpUrl.description: Attach to a running Chrome/Edge via CDP (e.g. http://localhost:9222, started with --remote-debugging-port) instead of launching a headless browser. browser_* tools then observe and act in the real browser.

computer.description: Computer-use (desktop control) integration. Disabled unless provider is set.

provider.description: Computer-use backend, served by the ax-computer server (canonical AX Computer protocol): "axnative" (macOS) or "cua" (cross-platform) select the server backend; "external" treats computer.command as a complete canonical-protocol MCP server. All values require a resolvable server command (computer.command, AX_COMPUTER_COMMAND, or ax-computer on PATH). Unset = computer tools unavailable.

command.description: Computer-use server command. Precedence: this config > AX_COMPUTER_COMMAND env > ax-computer on PATH. For aliases this is the ax-computer server; for "external" it is the full canonical-protocol server command.

args.description: Server command arguments (default: ["mcp", "--backend", <provider>] for aliases, [] for external)

overrides.description: Per-app provider overrides: map an application name (as observed by computer_snapshot) to "cua", "axnative", or "external". Observations and element acts against a matching app route to the named provider; everything else uses `provider`. Element ids are only valid against the provider that issued them — crossing providers requires a fresh observation.

grounder.description: Grounder fallback for natural-language computer_action targets. Optional; unset = describe targets unavailable.

model.description: Vision model used to resolve natural-language action targets to screenshot coordinates (e.g. a UI-TARS endpoint), as "provider/model"

strict.description: Cloud-operations strict mode (default: false). When true, destructive-classified bash commands are denied outright — the interactive bash_destructive ask is replaced by a hard deny — and the model is directed to the sanctioned ops workflow (ops_plan -> ops_diff -> ops_approve -> ops_apply with an approved plan token). Set in trusted config only; untrusted project config cannot enable it.

auto_resize.description: Automatically resize images that exceed limits before sending to the model (default: true)

max_base64_bytes.description: Maximum image size in base64 bytes (default: 5242880 = 5MiB)

context_recovery.description: Enable bounded current-session evidence recovery after compaction

mcp_tool_discovery.description: Discover MCP tool schemas on demand while keeping built-in tools eager

tail_reminders.description: Project changing task reminders after stable request history for cache experiments

read_only_recipes.description: Enable bounded declarative read-only tool recipes

openTelemetry.description: Enable OpenTelemetry spans for AI SDK calls (using the 'experimental_telemetry' flag)

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

autonomous_escalate_low_confidence.description: When autonomous mode auto-answers a clarification question with low confidence, escalate to the user instead of guessing. Default: true.

autonomous_strict_permission.description: When autonomous mode encounters a permission whose risk class is unknown, prompt instead of auto-approving. Default: true. Set false only to preserve legacy compatibility.

permission_idle_once.description: ADR-138: narrow exception to the interactive-only permission contract. Only fires while running unattended (autonomous) with the sandbox off (full-access). Each session's oldest pending ask gets 15 seconds; queued asks get a fresh countdown when promoted. Live mode changes cancel ineligible countdowns. The ask carries autoOnceAt so clients can render the countdown; any human reply cancels the deadline.

enabled.description: Idle 'Allow once': auto-reply once after a countdown for allowlisted interactive permissions. Default: true; the autonomous + full-access posture is the opt-in. Set false to disable.

timeout_ms.description: Deprecated: retained for config compatibility. Allow Once countdowns are fixed at 15000 ms.

permissions.description: Permissions that may auto-reply once. Default: every pending permission, including requireInteractive. Requires autonomous mode with full-access; WebMCP additionally requires its corresponding bridge to be connected.

autonomous_caps.description: Override the default autonomous-mode blast-radius caps. Any field omitted falls back to the constant default.

linesExemptPaths.description: Glob patterns whose writes count toward the file cap but not the line cap.

perTool.description: Per-tool call-count caps. 0 or negative disables the cap for that tool. Tools not listed are unrestricted at the per-tool layer.

planner_architect_model.description: Provider/model id used for plan generation and replanning when set; defaults to the executor model.

critic_enabled.description: Run the autonomous-mode diff critic at every phase boundary. Default: false.

modes.description: Execution modes: local, cloud, hybrid placement, multi-provider council, and arena ensemble (ADR-049).

default.description: Default execution mode. When unset: hybrid if local AX Engine is available, else cloud. Arena/council are typically invoked via tools rather than as the global default.

preferLocalWhenAvailable.description: Prefer local placement when AX Engine (or configured local) is available. Default: true.

escalateOnHighComplexity.description: Route high-complexity work to cloud when hybrid is active. Default: true.

localProviderID.description: Provider id treated as local for hybrid placement. Default: ax-engine.

enabled.description: Allow the council multi-provider advisory tool. Default: true.

maxMembers.description: Maximum council members per invocation (default: 3, hard max: 6).

timeoutMs.description: Per-member timeout in ms for council fan-out (default: 180000; reasoning models receive reasoningTimeoutScale times this budget).

reasoningTimeoutScale.description: Timeout multiplier applied to members whose model declares reasoning capability (default: 3). Raise when slow reasoning members (e.g. DeepSeek V4 Pro on large contexts) time out.

memberTimeoutMs.description: Absolute per-member timeout overrides in ms, keyed by "providerID" or "providerID/modelID". Takes precedence over timeoutMs and reasoningTimeoutScale for matching members.

debateRounds.description: Optional multi-round anonymous debate rounds (default: 0; Phase 3+).

chairman.description: Append one blinded chairman synthesis call after aggregation (default: false). Deterministic tiering remains the primary output; the chairman receives anonymized findings only.

adaptive.description: Adaptive fan-out (default: false): start council with two members and expand one at a time up to maxMembers while coverage is below quorum or dissent is material. Expansion triggers are harness-tunable constants.

enabled.description: Enable arena multi-contestant mode tools. Default: false; opt in per project.

timeoutMs.description: Per-member timeout in ms for arena fan-out (falls back to council timeout, then 60000).

reasoningTimeoutScale.description: Timeout multiplier applied to contestants whose model declares reasoning capability (falls back to modes.council.reasoningTimeoutScale, then 3).

memberTimeoutMs.description: Absolute per-contestant timeout overrides in ms, keyed by "providerID" or "providerID/modelID" (falls back to modes.council.memberTimeoutMs). Exact model keys win over provider-wide keys.

judge.description: Run one blinded rubric judge call to rank plan-mode proposals (default: true). The judge scores requirement coverage, feasibility, verification plan, and risk evidence; self-assessed risk remains display-only.

strategy.description: Ranking strategy for arena candidates. verify_first is the recommended default (never pure popularity).

maxEstimatedUsd.description: Maximum estimated USD for an ensemble fan-out (fail-closed when exceeded).

estimatedUsdPerMember.description: Rough USD cost per council/arena member call used with maxEstimatedUsd to cap fan-out size.

ensembleLedger.description: Append per-generation records to the local ensemble call ledger (default: true). Local JSONL with SHA-256 prompt hashes only — no prompt bodies, no egress; operational debug data, not AX Telemetry.

wiki.description: Native source-backed AX Wiki. Complements structural ax-code index; does not replace code_intelligence.

auto.description: Maintain Wiki in the background after interactive project idle. Default: true; false disables automatic maintenance.

enabled.description: When true (default), inject <repo_wiki> system protocol if the wiki directory exists. Set false to suppress.

dir.description: AX Wiki directory relative to project root. Default: .ax-wiki.

model.description: Model used for wiki compilation as provider/model. Defaults to the AX Code model.

autoInjectAgents.description: Allow wiki ensure-agents / init --wiki to rewrite AX-WIKI marker blocks. Default: true.

touchClaudeMd.description: When ensuring markers, also update CLAUDE.md if it already exists. Default: true.

include.description: Optional source glob allowlist for AX Wiki discovery.

exclude.description: Additional source globs excluded from AX Wiki discovery.

generationConcurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous Wiki page calls. Default: 2 for cloud models, 1 for local and CLI models.

maxSourcesPerPage.description: Maximum evidence files selected per page.

maxSourceBytes.description: Maximum bytes read from one source file.

maxPageSourceBytes.description: Maximum combined source evidence bytes per page.

instructions.description: Additional maintainer instructions applied during wiki compilation.

pages.description: Optional explicit wiki page plan; must include quickstart.md.

provider.description: Image generation provider. Defaults to openai if OPENAI_API_KEY is set.

apiKey.description: API key for the image generation provider.

baseURL.description: Custom base URL for the provider API.
